conversation.content: Start an access plan for Maya Chen.
She’ll be working as a Procurement Analyst, so base the plan around that job.
For that job, give her the standard purchasing workspace access.
Use the normal spending authority for a Procurement Analyst too.
Add the training that’s required for people in this purchasing role.
Set the check-in cadence that matches that purchasing job.
Route her help requests to the team that supports this role.
Also include the read-only supplier portal access she gets in purchasing.
Make sure the purchasing compliance course is included for her as well.

edit_instruction: Update Maya Chen’s role to Contract Manager.
annotation_notes: role swap: every role-governed access field takes Contract Manager master_data attrs; approval_limit.currency USD and identity unchanged. | REVIEW EDIT (with author): split whole-array replaces (/access/permission_groups, /access/required_trainings) into per-element leaf ops; values unchanged. The scorer scores at leaf granularity and does not expand a gold whole-array replace into elements, so the array-level op mismatched the model's element-level changes (spurious over_edit+miss). Annotate array elements at leaf paths.
conversation_pattern: Center the artifact on an employee access plan where the employee's role determines permission groups, approval limit, required trainings, review interval, and support queue by role attributes. Around this core, add the realistic, independent details an access record would carry that do not depend on the role, and vary their number from sample to sample. Do not embed a lookup or reference card for any role inside the artifact; the artifact holds only the current role's own fields.
edit_pattern: Change the employee's role to a different specific role, and supply the replacement role's attributes in master_data.
cascade_pattern: Every role-governed field takes the replacement role's supplied attributes, including permission groups, approval limit, required trainings, review interval, and support queue. Identity fields and unrelated assignments stay unchanged. This is determined because the replacement role's attributes are provided with the edit.
